one_sentence_story: By reciting 2,300 nonsense syllables to a 150-bpm metronome between 1879 and 1885, Hermann Ebbinghaus mapped the human Forgetting Curve — proving over half of raw rote material vanishes within one hour unless rescued by meaning, overnight sleep, and spaced review.
so_what_for_you: Stop cramming in one marathon block: review key new ideas briefly at +1 hour, +1 day, +3 days, and +7 days — and tie every dry fact to a vivid 'why' so it stops behaving like a nonsense syllable.
